note: Taaladvies.net, the advice service the Nederlandse Taalunie runs with the Instituut voor de Nederlandse Taal and Onze Taal. Same shape and same argument as fundeu-rae-es: the publisher's subject is correct Dutch, so its own typography is about as well set as published Dutch gets, and the 300 posts frozen into this list carry one straight apostrophe in 880,000 characters and no straight double quote at all. That absence is also why this corpus is here rather than a newspaper. NOS and VRT set their quotations with straight marks, so a Dutch news corpus would report a true positive on nearly every quotation, which measures recall rather than the false-positive rate these rules actually have; the official gazette is set properly and holds almost no apostrophes, two in twenty thousand characters, so it exposes nothing this pack is about; and DBNL is transcription rather than typesetting, which the header above disqualifies by name. What this corpus does not carry is the gap to close before nl ships, and it is visible in `exposes` by what is missing: no IJ digraph, so nl.ij-capital rests on no text at all, and no apostrophe after a digit, so nl.apostrophe-after-symbol rests on none either. Three of the 300 posts are about where a punctuation mark goes relative to a quotation mark, and so print quotation marks as their subject rather than to quote anything; they are kept, because dropping them before measuring would be picking by content.
